basic_info.description: Rarely available, top floor one-bedroom corner condominium in heart of the Marina. From red-roof tiles to ornate archways and beautiful metal work, this 1928 building epitomizes the Mediterranean architectural style; an example of why people chose to live in the neighborhood. Located directly across from Marina Green, walking distance to the vibrant shops, restaurants, and parks the Marina is known for. Natural light floods the oversized living space, highlighting the perfect balance of period details and modern updates. The living room features a wall of west and north facing windows with a view to the Golden Gate Bridge and the Bay. A dedicated dining room space features west facing windows and a Golden Gate bridge view as well. The large bedroom, with north facing windows, is large enough for a king bed and dedicated office area with a large walk-in closet. The large kitchen features expansive countertops and plenty of storage. In-unit laundry, a dedicated storage room and one car parking complete the unit. All the Marina has to offer is mere steps away. 91 Walk score and 92 Bike score.
